explanation: This component is 0 everywhere except at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (trial 95 onward), and only when the previous trial chose a1, reached S1 by the common transition and was rewarded; then it is about 6-8 at trials 95-96 and 9-10 at trials 97-99. At D1 after an unrewarded S1 visit it is about 0-2, and it is 0 at GO and D2, at any step before trial 95, and after any trial that reached S2 (rewarded or not) or chose a2.
